text:
Olivia P: Quick heads-up — we've had a handful of late-submission asks from EMEA folks because of public holidays. Proposing a targeted 24h extension for EMEA only (forms close for everyone else as scheduled). Any major objections?
Samir K: +1 for EMEA-only. reviewer queues already look tight for NA, so a blanket extension would be messy.
Maria G: We can do 24h, but that would push our calibration window. Currently calibration kickoff is Tue 10:00 PT — moving that by one day will affect reviewer availability. Do we want to nudge calibration or leave it and have a tighter reviewer turn?
Olivia P: Good point. Proposal A: extend EMEA forms by 24h, keep calibration Tue, ask reviewers on the calibration list to prioritize late submissions. Proposal B: extend forms & shift calibration +24h to Wed so reviewers get breathing room. Thoughts?
Kevin L: I'm on the calibration roster. I prefer Proposal B — last-minute reviews are lower quality. Shifting calibration by 24h is fine from infra/product side.
Samir K: From eng leads, moving calibration one day is ok as long as we keep the same time of day. We just need to tell impacted reviewers now.
Maria G: Agree with B. I'll update the calibration doc and bump the agenda items if we move. Also we should publish an explicit exception flow for reviewers who can't make the new time.
Olivia P: Action items then: (1) Approve 24h EMEA extension, (2) Shift calibration Tue->Wed 10:00 PT, (3) People Ops to send updated reviewer RSVP + exception instructions. I'll draft the announcement.
Juno (HR Bot): Reminder: current form cutoff = 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC. If People Ops confirms extension, I will auto-extend EMEA subset to 2026-03-26 23:59 UTC and post an update.
Samir K: Can we narrow "EMEA subset" to specific time zones so the bot doesn't accidentally extend APAC? e.g., GMT+0 to GMT+3 + CET?
Olivia P: Yes — we'll target EMEA working hours: UTC-1 through UTC+4. I'll include a short definition in the announcement.
Maria G: Also add a note about reviewer load: if you're a reviewer and can't take on extra late submissions, mark yourself as "no overflow" in the reviewer spreadsheet.
Kevin L: Suggest adding a callout for managers to pre-clear priority exceptions (LOAs, critical hires) so we can triage quickly during calibration.
Olivia P: Will do. Draft announcement (to post in #people-ops and email to reviewers):

```
Heads up — due to regional holidays we are approving a 24-hour extension to the review form deadline for EMEA contributors only. New EMEA form cutoff: 2026-03-26 23:59 UTC. Global cutoff remains 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC.
Calibration kickoff moved from Tue 2026-03-28 10:00 PT -> Wed 2026-03-29 10:00 PT. If you are scheduled as a reviewer and cannot attend the shifted calibration, please mark yourself in the reviewer sheet and flag your manager. Managers: please pre-clear any high-priority exception cases (LOA, new hires, critical roles) by EOD today.
People Ops will auto-update the form window for affected time zones and post an updated reviewer RSVP list. If you have questions, reply in-thread or ping @Olivia P.
```

Olivia P: I'll wait 2 hours for objections, then post. Anyone who needs a longer extension for a specific employee (e.g., documented LOA) please DM me now.
Samir K: No objections from eng leadership. Thanks for the clear plan. :thumbsup: \nMaria G: No objections from Talent Ops. Thanks.
Kevin L: LGTM.
Juno (HR Bot): Extension queued; will apply once People Ops confirms."
